region: TTR and modern type theories: scoped comparisons
summary: Explicit shared-carrier contract for witnesses and model variation. Shared-witness packages are recoverable from independent packages exactly on their aligned image. A zero-arity ptype/meet fragment is realized using the existing TTR, MTT and Ranta encodings; model transport requires explicit preservation/reflection hypotheses. Atomic truth agreement alone does not preserve meet inhabitation.
source_note: Comparison infrastructure, not a new formalization or assessment of an entire source. Consulted passages and SHA256 identities are recorded in audits/witness_contract_2026_09_25.md; source-level evidence links and grades are unchanged.

definitions_mapped.note: The shared carrier, equality and alignment criterion are explicit representation choices, not identical native noun ontologies.

definitions_mapped.source: Cooper A8, CL20 strong Sigma, Ranta propositions as types
definitions_mapped.note: Model-indexed realization of a zero-argument ptype and binary-meet fragment. Object-language codes are not identified with their extensions.
Compatibility hypotheses on explicit assignments and a carrier map; not source-authored notions of equivalence or arbitrary model changes.

evidence: Mechanical contract over specified encodings; no independent source-fidelity verdict or whole-theory equivalence.
simplifications: Fixed object/type-code domains; zero-arity ptypes and binary meet only; Prop-valued TTR satisfaction.
omissions: Dependent records, varying Type_M, signatures/coercive subtyping, general translations, counting and DTS resolution.
additions: Shared-carrier alignment interface, explicit translation maps and model-change conditions.

determination_rationale: Comparison infrastructure is not a source-level determination.
notes: See audits/witness_contract_2026_09_25.md and designs/ttr_mtt_ranta_contract_v0.md. The .mech.json sidecar records every named statement, compile check and assumption audit; claims.lock pins their fingerprints. No choice, proof irrelevance, functional extensionality or UIP is assumed.
